Facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the formation.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the packed ice is a 5x5 patch of blue blocks at the cliff's base (relative coords ~7-11, y0, z13-17) that must be visually located. Uses position_near_with_facing because the stone slab path is a diagonal line of 12 slabs that must be visually identified. Facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the slab path.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the iron door is a specific block on the north face of the stone brick building at (-5, 1, 0) that must be visually located. Max_distance=5 requires close approach to the building entrance. The door faces north (toward positive z), so the player approaching from the slab path direction will see it directly. Facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the door, not just standing near the building.
